correctness.rationale: Directly derive [a,b]=(xv+cyu)Z and [b,a]=(uy+cvx)Z. For c=-1 the two equations force linear dependence of projections, yielding q+1 cliques K_{q(q−1)}; for c=1 a nondegenerate hyperbolic orthogonality pairs q−1 nonaxis slopes into (q−1)/2 bicliques and leaves two axis cliques; for c^2≠1 the determinant (c²−1)xy isolates all nonaxis vectors and leaves two axis cliques. All have the universal q-element center. Clique generating functions follow from graph joins/unions. For repeated entries in a k-tuple, self-bracket=0 is necessary if repeated positions: this produces exactly the displayed three k-tuple formulas and identical pair but distinct triple counts for ±1. Congruence of the nondegenerate bilinear form gives similarity invariance of B_c^{-1}B_c^T=diag(1/c,c); invert c by exchanging X and Y. Independently enumerated every ordered pair over F3,F5,F7 (all c≠0), every triple over F3,F5, and checked exact k=1,2,3 formulas; not an all-q computation.
